name: gamepad-support-mindustry-mod
author: NTT & wareal-nah
description:
[accent]Full Cross-Platform Controller Support[] for Mindustry v154+ (Java 17).
Native support for [lightgray]Linux, Windows 10/11, macOS, and Android (including legacy versions)[].
Works out of the box with DualSense, DualShock 4, Xbox One/Series, and standard USB/Bluetooth gamepads.

[accent]Features:[]
• [white]3 Gameplay Modes:[] Normal (L2), Build (R1), and Command (L1)
• [white]Free Camera & Detachment:[] Scout anywhere on map with D-Pad; L2/L3 to snap back
• [white]Smart Building & Derelict Repair:[] Empty-cursor R2 repairs abandoned derelicts & broken plans; line build, area deconstruct, pipette, schematics
• [white]Full RTS Control:[] Box unit selection, target assignment, and command/stance cycling
• [white]Per-Category Stick Inversion:[] Separate OX/OY stick inversion for all 6 categories
• [white]UI & Menu Navigation:[] Virtual cursor with click, drag & scroll support
• [white]Full In-Game Settings:[] Rebindable buttons, sensitivity sliders, deadzone & axis tuning
